title: Daily digest: Inquilab Aayega: Jamia students continue | KTR tears into Revanth for prioritising  | Keralam has identified 10 potential site | Venkaiah Naidu calls for greater citizen
headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS
source: Munsif Daily / Telangana Today / The Hindu
bullets_en: Inquilab Aayega: Jamia students continue protest amid online classes.
KTR tears into Revanth for prioritising Musi beautification over drought-hit farmers.
Keralam has identified 10 potential sites for AIIMS, says Health Minister.
Venkaiah Naidu has sought greater citizen participation in building Viksit Bharat.
bullets_ur: Inquilab Aayega: Online classes ke dauran Jamia ke talba ka ehtijaj jari
KTR ne qahat-zada kisano par Musi beautification ko tarjeeh dene par Revanth par shiddat se tanqeed ki.
Keralam mein AIIMS ke liye 10 mumkinah maqamat ki nishandahi kar li gayi hai, Health Minister ka bayan.
Venkaiah Naidu ne Viksit Bharat ki tameer mein shehriyon ki ziyada shumooliyat ka taqaza kiya.
